Name: (CP) Configurable Qi's Crop Challenge
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
I hate Qi's Crop. We only get a few beans by playing normally, and have to spend weeks actively farming beans if we want to get those sweet 100 Qi Gems. No more! With this mod, you can make it easier (or harder) by changing:

[list]
[*]The challenge's duration
[*]The number of Qi Fruit you need to ship
[*]The reward
[*]The time it takes for the fruit to grow
[*]Whether the fruit regrows (like strawberries). Regrowth time is a quarter of the chosen growth time

[*]The minimum fruit harvested from each crop
[*]The maximum fruit harvested from each crop (fruit harvested is a random number between min and max)
[/list]
I recommend only changing one or two things from this list, or it'll get too easy. You can also turn the challenge off completely so you never see it again.

I won't add a way to change Qi Bean drop rates. Adjusting the number of fruit harvested from each crop has the same result, more fruit.

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]The fruit number in the quest text isn't changed because I didn't want to, but you can see the right amount in the progress bar
[*]Challenge settings (duration, quantity needed, reward) are only applied to challenges you accept after changing the settings
[*]Qi Fruit wobble like crazy when collided with if you make them grow faster than 4 days (the wobble animation is meant for a little sprout and not a fully grown fruit)

[/list]
[size=5]Requirements
[/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 2.1.2+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ 1.12.0+

[/list]
